description:
Apply the frozen adoption rules to the unroll, consumer-specific dispatch, and ISA-L comparison evidence, producing one auditable logical-buffer outcome.

## Background

Selection uses confidence-bound whole-consumer benefit, equivalence non-regression, maintenance complexity, and declared dispatch domain. External throughput alone cannot select a production route, and the established implementation remains when no candidate qualifies.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The decision evaluates each candidate against the predeclared worthwhile-effect, equivalence-margin, complexity, and multiple-comparison rules using only confirmatory evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: At most one bounded production change is selected with its exact dispatch domain and required before/after cells, or a no-adoption outcome preserves the established route and all losing evidence.
- [hard] REQ-03: The preserved 64-word generic-hoist no-win is not reopened without a materially different consumer contract.

## Notes

The decision record is the only authority consumed by the conditional adoption task.
title: Select the logical-buffer production outcome
